description: This file defines a controller class 'Password' for handling password management in the account section of an OpenCart-based e-commerce application. It includes methods for displaying the password change form and saving the new password, with validation and appropriate redirects.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: Controller class for handling password change functionality within the account section, extending the core system controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the password change form with appropriate breadcrumbs, page title, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the password change request, including validation of password complexity, matching confirmation, updates the customer password, and returns JSON response.
